title: cyperus longus f. badiiformis
intro: Cyperus longus f. badiiformis, commonly known as bald cyperus or flaxgrassy papyrus, is a species of sedge that belongs to the Cyperaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. Cyperus longus f. badiiformis has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting urinary function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer effects.
